name: Izo
source:
[i]"Your face has stirred something in me... I will abduct you. Be prepared!"[/i]

Izo is very passionate about his job and a very serious man, as well as an extremely talented gardener. He is very taciturn, and doesn't talk about much outside of his work, but this is the kind of person that often turns out to be remarkably passionate once they open up.

Of course, he is from a different social stratum than you. So please, milady! Do not become too familiar with him!

[[url=https://shall-we-date.fandom.com/wiki/Izo]From Hinata's notes[/url]]
